title: The Football Pool plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'shouttext' parameter in…
description: The Football Pool WordPress plugin up to version 2.13.5 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'shouttext' parameter. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute in the admin Edit view for a shout. Other views such as the public Shoutbox widget and admin list view properly escape output, limiting the impact to the admin Edit view.
